fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Reliable Political News Coverage on YouTube - How YouTube Works
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: Users all over the world come to YouTube for news and information about elections - from finding reliable information about voting, candidates and election results to being able to access major election-related live moments – such as debates and election event coverage. In addition, to expand access to election-related live content, livestreams of major election-related live moments – such as debates and election event coverage –  may show on your homepage or at the top of your search results when you search for videos related to select national elections live moments. Candidate information panels may show at the top of your search results when you search for the names of eligible candidates. Voting information panels may show at the top of your search results when you search for info on how to vote. Election results information panels may show at the top of your search results when you search for videos related to select national elections.

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: How to Vote - SC Votes - South Carolina Election Commission
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: ## Voting System FAQs. South Carolina’s old voting system was implemented in 2004 and is reaching the end of its expected useful life of 15 years. Having a paper record of each voter’s voted ballot will add an additional layer of security as it allows for audits of paper ballots to verify vote totals. The ExpressVote ballot-marking system from Election Systems & Software (ES&S). The ExpressVote is a ballot-marking device (BMD). A BMD is a device that helps voters mark a paper ballot more accurately and efficiently. A voter’s choices are presented on a screen in a similar manner to a voting machine. Instead, it allows the voter to mark the choices on-screen and, when the voter is done, prints the ballot selections. To vote on the ExpressVote, you will show your Photo ID, confirm your address, and sign the poll list as normal. You will then have the opportunity to review your selections printed on the ballot before inserting it into a ballot scanner.
